meta.name: Aar Ya Paar
meta.description: When the modern world's greed destroys his idyllic tribal existence, a valiant archer becomes a deadly assassin to get even.

videos.title: Sarju, The Beginning
videos.overview: A unique find at Dhegohaat forest’s mining site stirs a desire in Rueben Bhatta to own the government-protected land. But it’s home to an idyllic tribe who hate intruders.

videos.title: The Dalal
videos.overview: Bhatta gets in Dr. Sanghamitra Das to lure the Dhegohaatis. Meanwhile, Special Crimes officer Aditya Dutt launches a manhunt for a broker of contract killings, Pullappa.

videos.title: Battle Cry
videos.overview: Dutt readies to make a move against Pullappa. In the wake of a personal tragedy, Sarju accompanies Sanghamitra to the city in search of the masterminds behind the massacre.

videos.title: Gold Medallist
videos.overview: Pullappa seizes an opportunity and uses Sarju to get his job done. While Sanghamitra turns whistleblower, Dutt takes charge of the medical camp massacre case.

videos.title: Setu Lam
videos.overview: Sarju races to save Kisna from Dutt’s captive. Meanwhile, Pullappa forges a nearly-impossible plan to kill Bhatta in Georgia and Dutt discovers the identity of the attacker.

videos.title: Final Countdown
videos.overview: Sarju and Pullappa seek covert assistance to find Bhatta. While Sanghamitra faces tough questions about Setu Lam, Dutt prepares to leave for Azerbaijan.

videos.title: The Devil Inside
videos.overview: Racing against the clock, Dutt hunts for Sarju. With an impending danger lurking around Dhegohaatis, things point to a certain destruction. Will there be a way out?
